study type: Basic science/Preclinical (lineage tracing, cellular experiments) with retrospective analysis of human patient data
outcome: Identification of mammary stem cells and progenitors
Patient outcome (prognosis in basal breast cancer)
cohort: The study involved bipotent mammary stem cells and unipotent basal mammary progenitors in embryonic, perinatal, and postnatal mammary glands (likely animal models), and human patients with the basal breast cancer subtype.
finding: Gpr125 serves as a specific marker for multiple mammary stem and progenitor cells, influencing their characteristics and movement, and its high expression is linked to poor outcomes in basal breast cancer patients.
